run.answer:
**Review complete.** I found three requests worth pursuing and submitted all three:

- **ShopMart duplicate charge — $126.96:** Two charges posted on September 16, while the order email says there was one order that day. ShopMart received request **SM-1001**.
- **ShopMart missing return refund — $44.62:** The August 25 return email says the refund was processed, but I found no matching inflow in Harbor Checking. ShopMart received request **SM-1002**.
- **StreamFlix loyalty pricing:** The monthly charge rose from $13.99 to $17.99 starting in August. I asked support to apply any available loyalty pricing without changing or cancelling the plan. Ticket **SF-1003** was created.

I saved the opportunities and scheduled follow-ups: ShopMart on **October 20** and StreamFlix on **October 23**. I also saved the recurring-charge inventory for Metro Power, StreamFlix, Spotify, and Oakview Apartments; the records don’t say whether any are unwanted, so I didn’t change them.

No refund has been confirmed as received.

verify_run.answer:
Found and recorded two posted ShopMart refunds: **$126.96** for the duplicate charge and **$44.62** for return SM-54039. The ShopMart duplicate case and StreamFlix loyalty request now show as received. StreamFlix’s **$12 loyalty credit** also posted; I scheduled a follow-up for **October 23** to check whether its ongoing price changed.

The $44.62 return opportunity remains open and marked submitted in saved work; attempts to update it failed because the tool returned “Record not found.” I couldn’t verify or submit through the browser: its workspace opened, but it had no control and showed a blank page.

I found recurring-charge leads for Spotify, Oakview Apartments, Metro Power, and StreamFlix, but no unread note saying any are unused. No approval case was warranted based on the sources reviewed.
